# ISOtunes

> ISOtunes manufactures Bluetooth hearing protection earbuds and earmuffs with advanced sound control technology for industrial, construction, hunting, and recreational use.

ISOtunes, a Haven Technologies brand, specializes in certified hearing protection devices that combine ANSI/OSHA/NIOSH compliance with innovative technologies like Aware Technology, Tactical Sound Control, and SafeMax volume limiting. The product line serves diverse industries including construction, lawn care, woodworking, and tactical applications.

## Key Topics

- Aware Technology
- Tactical Sound Control

## Core Products

- [Hearing Protection Earbuds](https://isotunes.com/collections/hearing-protection-earbuds): ISOtunes award-winning Bluetooth earbuds with Aware Technology for hearing protection and environmental awareness.
- [Hearing Protection Earmuffs](https://isotunes.com/collections/earmuffs): ISOtunes Bluetooth earmuffs with Tactical Sound Control technology for industrial and tactical applications.
- [ISOtunes Sport](https://isotunes.com/pages/sport): ISOtunes Sport hunting and shooting earbuds product line designed for tactical noise suppression.
- [Replacement Parts & Accessories](https://isotunes.com/collections/accessories): Replacement eartips, cases, chargers, and accessories for ISOtunes hearing protection devices.

## Industry Solutions

- [Industrial Hearing Protection](https://isotunes.com/pages/industrial-hearing-protection): Industrial workplace hearing protection with team communication features and safety technology.
- [Construction Hearing Protection](https://isotunes.com/pages/construction): ISOtunes hearing protection specifically designed for construction industry workers and noise environments.
- [Lawn Care & Outdoor Equipment](https://isotunes.com/pages/lawncare): ISOtunes hearing protection for lawn care and outdoor equipment operation with noise suppression.
- [Woodworking & Workshop](https://isotunes.com/pages/workshop): ISOtunes hearing protection for woodworking and workshop safety with hearing conservation.

## Technology & Innovation

- [Aware Technology](https://isotunes.com/pages/aware-technology): Aware Technology explanation for hearing protection and environmental awareness capabilities.
- [Tactical Sound Control](https://isotunes.com/pages/tactical-sound-control): Tactical Sound Control technology for gunshot noise suppression and impulse noise protection.
- [SafeMax Hearing Conservation Technology](https://isotunes.com/pages/safemax-hearing-conservation-technology): SafeMax volume-limiting technology to prevent noise-induced hearing loss in high-noise environments.
- [Bluetooth Technology](https://isotunes.com/pages/bluetooth-technology): Bluetooth wireless technology integration in ISOtunes devices for connectivity and communication.
